# Invalid JSON test cases
# Format: one JSON string per line that should fail to parse

# Empty/whitespace
 
   

# Incomplete structures
{
[
"unclosed string
{"key": "value"
[1, 2, 3

# Trailing commas
[1, 2,]
{"a": 1,}

# Missing separators
[1 2 3]
{"a": 1 "b": 2}
{key: "value"}

# Invalid values
undefined
NaN
Infinity
0x1A
'single quotes'

# Number errors
01
+42
1.
1e
1e+

# Mismatched brackets
[}
{]
{"a": [}
